effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Util_Split_Screen_Left_Slide_Out
effectgroup.description: Out half of Split_Screen_Left_Slide_In: the left half slides back out of its edge (15 frames, cubic ease-in). Razor 15 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden).
